scope: Existing native stochastic PPO event; CPU only, no remote writes, no simulator/model/GPU/PPO/evaluation/TB server.
comparison_scope: Sampled training statistics are separate from deterministic mean-policy qualification; different actor ages/curriculum/DR cannot establish a same-difficulty single-variable benefit.

window.baseline_evidence: actual95-group Behavior after ten or more actor updates

yaw_observability.reason: Frozen native generic95-group producer logs yaw MAE/RMSE but no signed angular-velocity mean; MAE cannot reconstruct actual yaw rate.

denominator_scope.episodes: ended native episodes = failures + successes + timeouts; not actor updates
denominator_scope.frames: post-episode-warmup observer physical frames; stochastic resets/prefix frames remain
denominator_scope.stationary: completed eligible10s windows, samples-weighted; zero count means unavailable
denominator_scope.lesson: 24-frame averaged cumulative counters; no exact ended-rate

behavior.means_scope: Cumulative native frame-weighted means; resets, stochastic actions and prefix physical frames remain.
behavior.recovery_scope: 54 static group labels mix reset-selected lessons; not original_chain-only success.

stationary_10s.scope: Windows completed in these rollouts; an anchor may precede the interval.

dynamic_lessons.fraction_scope: Time-averaged instantaneous lesson success/population; not ended-episode success rate.

learning_ownership.scope: Only policy_learning_mask-valid transitions can learn; other physical frames include SCRIPT/BLEND/passive birth.

optional_conditional_stop_phases.scope: Native braking/settled_stop-mask physical samples, weighted by samples; whole start-stop motion is not parking.

optional_posture_reward_density.scope: Reward densities/costs, not measured pitch/roll angles.

limitations: Stochastic training with resets/DR/physical prefix; not a deterministic mean-policy rollout.
Behavior float32 event means are differenced with native integer frame counts; lifetime maxima cannot yield interval extrema.
Recovery static group names do not identify dynamically sampled lesson levels.
Lesson cumulative counters are 24-frame rollout averages; their endpoint differences are not exact episode integers.
Completed stationary windows need2s quiet then10s with height error<=10mm; anchors can precede this actor window; target need not stay fixed.
Missing observations are unavailable, never imputed zero; zero completed stationary samples provide no stationary success evidence.
Ten critic-only collections remain in native cumulative frame denominators, but the selected dense intervals and reported task actor endpoints exclude those updates.
Static group command means cannot certify L0-specific nonzero goal exposure; actual L0 motion release and exposure are unavailable in this event schema.
Source023 sets recovery entropy coefficient to zero and charges ten critic adaptation updates; this stochastic window is descriptive, not causal or functional qualification.

actual_L0_motion_release.reason: Frozen native TB has no per-lesson motion_released tag; hold population is not a release count.

actual_L0_nonzero_goal_exposure.reason: Static recovery groups mix lesson levels; group command means cannot certify L0-specific exposure.

scopes: HoldCost fields are24-policy-frame averages of per-frame actor-hold conditional means; not exact lane sums or motor current.

Instantaneous gate pass fractions and historical stable peaks are not continuous1s completion probabilities.
release_seconds is configured zero-torque release duration; not the instant of motion release.
L0 lesson success cannot credit original-chain success or hardware qualification.
